tool_args.rationale: The previous submission failed because fit did not initialize the parameter state used by predict. This corrected, self-contained submission numerically fits the two parameters of the coarse adiabatic law on all eight paid rows and shares the fitted values with predict for fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The fine trajectory batch already increased the dataset to eight rows; that is enough to fit and distinguish the coarse adiabatic law from a static linear response without additional measurement cost.
The training outputs show small systematic dependence on x_now as well as u_now, so an H-independent model omits the transient structure suggested by the supplied signatures.
It depends on u_now and H but does not account for the observed x_now dependence.
Its viscosity-only form does not capture the x_now transient; the available data instead motivate the stated adiabatic relaxation law.
